fullPassage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. The key questions are not simply "where" questions, though; they are "why there" and "so what" questions. Getting to such questions means taking spatial arrangements, variations, and interconnections seriously. Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some appreciation of spatial circumstances — where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like. Moving up in scale, without some awareness of how phenomena are arranged on Earth's surface, it is difficult to make reasoned business or policy judgments, make sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces shaping life on the planet. Locating a new store or public service requires taking into consideration population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more. Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of discrimination, socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.

det.korean: 'is + 과거분사' 수동태 구문이다. 하나의 단어가 지리학과 연관'되는' 것이므로 수동태 associated가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①associated: is + p.p. 수동태 (be associated with = ~와 연관되다)
❌ ②associating: 능동 진행형이 되어 의미 부적절
❌ ③associates: 동사 3인칭 단수형, is와 중복
❌ ④associate: 동사 원형, is와 결합 불가
det.tip: be associated with = ~와 연관되다 (수동태 숙어 표현)

questions.passage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. __________ is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. det.korean: 'That is because ~'는 '그것은 ~때문이다'라는 고정 표현이다. 앞 문장 전체를 가리키는 지시대명사 That이 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ①That: 지시대명사, 앞 문장을 받아 That is because 구문
❌ ②what: 관계대명사/의문사, 여기서 문법적으로 부적절
❌ ③which: 관계대명사, 독립절에서 주어로 부적절
❌ ④where: 장소 부사, 주어 자리에 부적절
det.tip: That is because ~ = 그것은 ~때문이다 (이유를 설명하는 표현)

questions.passage: One word is inextricably associated with geography: where. That is because geography starts from the premise that it matters where something takes place on Earth's surface. det.korean: 문장의 주어 자리이므로 동명사 Getting이 적절하다. 'Getting to such questions'이 주어이고 means가 동사이다.

❌ ①Get: 동사원형은 주어가 될 수 없음
❌ ②Got: 과거형, 주어 불가

Moving up in scale, without some awareness of how phenomena are arranged on Earth's surface, it is difficult ①<u>to make</u> reasoned business or policy judgments, ②<u>making</u> sense of events, or grasp some of the basic forces ③<u>shaping</u> life on the planet.

det.korean: ②making은 to make, grasp와 병렬 구조를 이루어야 하므로 make가 되어야 한다. it is difficult to make A, make sense of B, or grasp C의 병렬 구조이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ②making → make: to make / make sense of / grasp의 병렬 구조 (to 생략된 원형부정사)
✅ ①to make: it is difficult to V 구문의 진목적어
✅ ③shaping: 현재분사, forces를 수식 (forces shaping life = 삶을 형성하는 힘들)
det.tip: 병렬 구조: to make A, (to) make sense of B, or (to) grasp C — to 이하에서 동사원형이 나열된다

❌ ③requiring: 분사형, 동사 자리에 부적절

questions.passage: Engaging in even the simplest day-to-day activity requires some __________ (appreciate) of spatial circumstances — where to find food and services, how to get to work places, and the like.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: appreciate(동사) → appreciation(명사): some + 명사 자리이므로 명사형으로 변환해야 한다.
det.analysis:
appreciate → appreciation: 동사 → 명사 변환
'some appreciation of ~' = ~에 대한 어느 정도의 이해/인식 (some + 명사 구조)
det.tip: appreciate(동사: 인식하다/감사하다) → appreciation(명사: 인식/감사) — -ate → -ation 명사화

questions.passage: Locating a new store or public service requires taking into __________ (consider) population distributions, the location of roads and utilities, socio-economic patterns, and more.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: consider(동사) → consideration(명사): take into consideration(~을 고려하다) 숙어 표현에서 명사가 필요하다.
det.analysis:
consider → consideration: 동사 → 명사 변환
'take into consideration' = ~을 고려하다 (숙어 표현)
det.tip: take into consideration = consider = ~을 고려하다. consideration은 consider의 명사형

questions.passage: Understanding why and where migration happens requires consideration of the political organization of territory, the spatial consequences of __________ (discriminate), socio-economic patterns, and the layout of the physical environment.

discriminate → discrimination: 동사 → 명사 변환
'the spatial consequences of discrimination' = 차별의 공간적 결과 (of + 명사 구조)
det.tip: discriminate(동사: 차별하다) → discrimination(명사: 차별) — -ate → -ation 명사화

inextricable → inextricably: 형용사 → 부사 변환
'inextricably associated' = 불가분하게 연관된 (부사가 분사를 수식)
det.tip: inextricable(분리할 수 없는, 형용사) → inextricably(분리할 수 없게, 부사) — -ble → -bly 부사화
